title: IBAA Interdenominational Study Circle — Dhammakaya Meditation Center California
youtubeTitle: IBAA Interdenominational Study Circle at Dhammakaya Meditation Center California — August 22, 2026 recording
minutes: IBAA held its Los Angeles-area interdenominational Dharma Meeting at Dhammakaya Meditation Center California on August 22, 2026, from 3:00 to 5:00 pm PST. The program followed the IBAA format of opening chanting from the three traditions, Triple Refuge and Five Precepts, Dharma talks from Theravada, Mahayana, and Vajrayana venerables, meditation, and closing chanting. The host temple recorded the meeting. The recording is embedded below.
